notes: Hand-authored, not derived. Rule: the two halves the prompt asks for, one file each. src/server/services/session-service.ts declares SESSION_TTL_DAYS and stamps expiresAt when createSessionToken() mints the session; src/lib/session.ts is where an already-issued session is judged stale — getSessionPrincipal() compares parseIso(principal.expiresAt) against Date.now() and returns null, and setSessionCookie() copies the same instant onto the cookie. EXCLUDED: src/server/repositories/session-repository.ts (stores and purges rows against a timestamp handed to it; purgeExpiredSessions is the sweep, not the per-request decision); src/lib/actor.ts (turns a null principal into an error); src/schemas/session.ts (cookie name and shape); src/lib/date.ts (parseIso is a generic date helper).
